note: The family write rules as steps (docs/groups-mobile-plan.md, core step 1). Both twins run every scenario on their own ledger (packages/crypto/src/area-ledger-testkit.ts, crates/hushos-core/tests/common/area_ledger.rs); each step with an `expect` must give exactly it, and each twin's fixture holds every step's outcome for the other to match.

scenarios.name: a family folder takes writes once its top level is the one the member list committed to
a top level under the right folder key but not the committed one opens nothing and makes nothing writable
a grant below the latest version, or a server behind or ahead of the chain, blocks writes
a folder reached only through the previous top-level key reads but takes no write
the walk re-keys it under the committed top level, and once the server takes the batch it takes writes again
a refused batch drops the walk's fresh keys and leaves the old ones as they were
a key a walk made before the folder's next member list landed takes no write
a node planted at the walk's target under a folder's old key is not carried, and one under the re-keyed folder is
a version a format 1 roster listed keeps the envelope rule, and a format 2 version after the switch does not
a deleted family folder is read but never written again
a refused chain stops writes until one is committed again, and forgetting the family wipes its keys
the next member list makes every key rooted at the earlier version read-only until the walk
the top level's previous key this device opened itself outranks a previous envelope the server serves
a cached top level is taken again only under the area version it was opened under
a folder's top level is never a walk's, even one this device cannot open
a top level listed under another area version is opened from its envelope, not taken from the cache
a key reached through a folder's previous key is rooted nowhere, even at the area's own version number
